conditional.name: ZONE_ACTIVE
conditional.condition_statement: Zone has an active block (type the zone name; = has one, != has none)
conditional.description: NAME zone LOGIC STRING has an active block

event.name: Block Started
event.description: A block started in a zone (EVENT_ZONE and EVENT_BLOCK say which)

event.name: Block Ended
event.description: A block ended in a zone (EVENT_ZONE and EVENT_BLOCK say which)

event.name: Schedule Edited
event.description: Someone changed the schedule from the page

event.name: Schedule Halted
event.description: The SmartBuildOS licence halted the schedule: no more block actions, the page stays readable

event.name: Schedule Restored
event.description: The schedule is running again after a halt

command.name: RUN_BLOCK_NOW
command.description: Run the block named BLOCK in zone ZONE right now. It holds until the schedule moves on from what was running.

command.name: PAUSE_SCHEDULE
command.description: Stop all block actions until resumed (the page stays readable)

command.name: RESUME_SCHEDULE
command.description: Resume the schedule; the block that should be running is picked up

command.name: SKIP_NEXT_BLOCK
command.description: Skip the next block that would start in ZONE (empty or ALL: every zone)

command.name: RELOAD
command.description: Re-read the zone properties and device lists and re-check the schedule

property.name: Manager PIN
property.description: The PIN staff type on the schedule page before a change is saved. Empty means the page is read-only. Five wrong PINs lock edits for a minute.

property.name: Volume Ramp Seconds
property.description: How long the volume takes to move to a block's level when the block starts. 0 sets it at once.

property.name: End Behaviour
property.description: What happens when a block ends and no other block follows: Hold leaves everything as it is, Fade Out lowers the volume to nothing and turns the room off, Off turns the room and the zone displays off at once.

property.name: Fade Out Seconds
property.description: How long the fade takes when End Behaviour is Fade Out.

property.name: Device List Filter
property.description: Optional text. Only devices whose name or room contains it appear in the source and display lists. Empty lists every device.

property.name: Zone 1 Name
